entries.name: META_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: A system user access token from the store's Meta Business account, holding the ads_read permission only, with the ad account assigned to the system user. The connector stops if the token holds anything more, such as ads_management or business_management. A system user token doesn't expire unless it is revoked.
howToGet: In Meta Business Settings, open Users > System users and add a system user with the Employee role (a user made for Brain A is best).
Assign the store's ad account to it with View performance access only.
Choose Generate new token, pick an app the business owns, and tick only ads_read.
Copy the token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: META_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.description: The numeric id of the ad account Brain A reads, with or without act_. Not a secret.
howToGet: In Meta Ads Manager, the ad account id is in the account menu at the top left, or in Business Settings > Accounts > Ad accounts.
